keyPhrases.text: smart, savagely funny and visionary new work
Way, way too much preaching to the audience
Robin Williams mails it in and looks totally uninterested
Complete waste of money and time
Beautifully directed, wonderfully acted and so thought-provoking

reasoning: This aggregated review presents sharply divided opinions. While the professional critic gave a rave review with superlatives like 'smart, savagely funny and visionary,' reader responses are polarized. Negative comments criticize the script as preachy, Williams' performance as disengaged, and call it a 'waste of money.' However, positive readers praise its creativity, direction, acting, and thought-provoking nature. The split between harsh criticism and genuine praise, with no clear consensus, places this in mixed territory.
